Earlier each and every person (e) very careful of social value. But at present our social  value is in a great threat. Young people don't (f) duly to their elders that results in social degradation. As a   result, peace and order and decent life are greatly (g) . So with a view to (h) peace and order in the society,   social value is badly (i) .
